moves.what_it_does: Relaunch a worker with a reviewed serving profile (model, parser, chat template, flags and limits). Repairs a worker whose configuration differs from the reviewed one. Takes the worker out of rotation while it restarts.

payload.expected_effect: target‑b will be relaunched with the reviewed serving profile; configuration keys (chat_template, tool_call_parser, tool_parser_plugin) will match the reviewed baseline; error rate should drop to 0.0 and latency stabilize; the worker is temporarily removed from rotation during restart.
payload.reasoning: target-b has a persistent 1.0 error rate and its configuration differs from the reviewed baseline on three keys (chat_template, tool_call_parser, tool_parser_plugin). The visible tool‑call canary also failed (HTTP 0, no structured tool calls). The only move that directly addresses this mis‑configuration is apply‑serving‑profile with the reviewed profile qwen25‑coder‑7b.tools‑template, which will relaunch target‑b with the correct settings. target‑a is already healthy, so no action is needed there.
payload.risk: The profile name provided (qwen25-coder-7b.tools-template) must exist in the system; if the profile is missing or mismatched the worker may fail to start. No other resources are affected.
